subject: Execution Launch -> First Persistent Artifact Admission

rationale: General Execution already owns provider-neutral execution identity, authority consumption, durable dispatch identity and restart/reconciliation semantics.
Build Colony native RunManifest begins after target Profile and immutable source revision exist; its cross-system AdmissionReceipt explicitly keeps execution_authorized=false.
Red Team Project Assurance is a domain executor rather than a cross-executor launch owner.
System Interoperability Envelope/ECL is a stateless binder and explicitly owns no database, scheduler, retry ledger or merged execution state.
CII and DI are advisory/read-only, Continuity Check is read-only, and Durable Execution is downstream of materialized execution events.

systemic_cause_assessment.statement: Before ELG-01, there was no enforced persistent provider-neutral contract between an authenticated executable order and executor-native launch materialization. Existing systems began either before execution semantics (conversation/ECL/advisory layers) or after native work/run materialization.
systemic_cause_assessment.common_internal_root_cause_statement: The two historical BrowserCoin cases still do not have a proven common internal reason for why their native executor/tool invocation was not initially materialized. ELG-01 repairs the shared observability/admission boundary only.

repair.name: Explicit Execution Order -> Launch Admission Receipt

before_state_machine: UNOBSERVABLE GAP: no canonical execution-admission identity
executor-native launch may or may not materialize
Build Colony/Red Team artifact if native launch succeeds
Durable visibility only after persistent downstream evidence exists

dispositions.ADMITTED: persistent receipt + workstream identity + launch_id + dispatch_identity + optional known first artifact; recovery_required until first artifact is observed
dispositions.HUMAN_GATE: persistent receipt identifying missing/insufficient authority; no launch identity
dispositions.REJECTED: persistent receipt identifying invalid/missing identity or authority actor substitution; no launch identity
dispositions.FAILED_BEFORE_LAUNCH: persistent receipt identifying executor unavailability/capability failure; no launch identity

after_state_machine.downstream: executor-native work remains executor-owned; later repository/Build Colony/provider/Durable evidence outranks the launch receipt

idempotency_and_recovery.crash_immediately_before_receipt: The immutable launch order remains persistent; replay deterministically regenerates the same receipt.
idempotency_and_recovery.crash_immediately_after_receipt: Exact replay returns ALREADY_RECORDED and reproduces the same receipt/workstream binding.
idempotency_and_recovery.crash_before_first_substantive_artifact: ADMITTED receipt remains with recovery_required=true and Continuity Check reports CHECKPOINTED_RESUMABLE unless bounded recovery is explicitly exhausted.
idempotency_and_recovery.duplicate_execution_order: Exact duplicate reproduces the same order/receipt identities.
idempotency_and_recovery.retry_replay_same_order: Idempotent; live host replay proven ALREADY_RECORDED.
idempotency_and_recovery.same_workstream_twice: A different order digest for an already-bound workstream fails closed; no second launch identity is created.
idempotency_and_recovery.build_colony_bootstrap_failure: Explicit downstream workload failure is reported FAILED while the earlier ADMITTED receipt remains immutable evidence.
idempotency_and_recovery.durable_temporarily_unavailable: Launch receipt remains CHECKPOINTED_RESUMABLE and infrastructure is reported unavailable.
idempotency_and_recovery.branch_without_substantive_artifact: Launch receipt makes the state CHECKPOINTED_RESUMABLE rather than silent.
idempotency_and_recovery.artifact_created_but_not_discovered: Continuity Check does not invent the artifact; it retains the launch checkpoint until stronger evidence is discovered.
idempotency_and_recovery.conversation_terminated_after_launch: Persistent launch evidence remains observable; conversation interruption does not erase development state.
idempotency_and_recovery.conversation_active_while_launch_fails: Explicit launch failure remains FAILED; open conversation does not imply progress.

regression_and_adversarial_results.case: crash immediately before receipt deterministic regeneration
Build Colony bootstrap failure before first artifact

replay_red_team_browsercoin.expected_new_behavior: The historical executable order produces a deterministic ADMITTED launch receipt and dispatch identity before Project Assurance substantive work. If Project Assurance never materializes its report, the launch remains discoverable/resumable instead of conversation-only.

replay_fae_browsercoin_design_assurance.historical_problem_state: branch created / execution body not yet persisted
replay_fae_browsercoin_design_assurance.expected_new_behavior: The branch-only interval remains bound to an ADMITTED receipt/dispatch identity and classifies CHECKPOINTED_RESUMABLE until Build Colony/Durable evidence appears.
replay_fae_browsercoin_design_assurance.convergence: Later Build Colony evidence becomes the stronger execution evidence without rewriting the immutable launch receipt.

positive_control.statement: When stronger Durable running evidence exists, Continuity Check keeps DEVELOPMENT_PROGRESSING; ELG-01 does not replace or duplicate the native Durable path.

residual_risks: ELG-01 does not itself hook the ChatGPT conversation product. A caller that accepts an executable conversational order must materialize the authenticated launch-order artifact before describing the work as launched.

ELG-01 v1 persists and classifies launch admission but deliberately does not dispatch the native executor; executor-specific adapters must consume/bind dispatch_identity if automatic launch is desired.

github-actions[bot] is intentionally limited to authority-free launch orders in the canonical host; authority-bearing unattended launch requires a separately proven immutable authority-authentication adapter.
The common internal root cause of the two historical BrowserCoin non-launches remains unproven.
A first substantive artifact that exists but is not discoverable remains unknown to Continuity Check; ELG-01 prevents silence by preserving the launch checkpoint but does not fabricate discovery.
